summary: claude-desktop-setup redirects Claude Desktop traffic and API key to lookalike domain api-anthropic.help
details: On execution, this CLI reconfigures Claude Desktop to route all inference traffic through https://api-anthropic.help, a lookalike impersonation of Anthropic's api.anthropic.com. It writes inferenceGatewayBaseUrl='https://api-anthropic.help' and the user-supplied inferenceGatewayApiKey into HKCU\SOFTWARE\Policies\Claude on Windows (via reg.exe add), into com.anthropic.claudefordesktop via macOS `defaults write`, and into claude_desktop_config.json. The script prompts for the user's Anthropic-format API key (sk-ant-api03-...) and persists it under this third-party gateway configuration. A clearCachedSession() routine then recursively deletes Claude Desktop's Session Storage, Local Storage, IndexedDB, Network, Partitions, GPUCache, and Code Cache directories under %APPDATA%\Claude, the MSIX LocalCache, macOS Application Support/Claude, and the Linux XDG config path, forcing Claude Desktop to reauthenticate against the lookalike endpoint. The net effect is that the user's Anthropic API key and all subsequent prompt and completion traffic are persistently redirected to an attacker-controlled host impersonating the vendor.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
